# g29ctl command transcripts (G29.Cli.Program.Run with the Main error handler).
# Frozen from the legacy C# implementation by tools/G29.Reference (reference.ps1).
# Do not edit by hand. These vectors are the oracle for the Brainfuck port.
# case <argv joined by '|'> ; wheel <none|native|compat|ps4|two>
# then discovery events, 'out <line>' / 'err <line>' console output, and 'exit <code>'

case  ; wheel native
out G29 Standalone: Logitech G29 controller without G HUB
out 
out Commands:
out   g29ctl status
out   g29ctl doctor
out   g29ctl init [--range 40..900] [--autocenter 0..100]
out   g29ctl range <40..900>
out   g29ctl autocenter <0..100>
out   g29ctl leds <0..31>
out   g29ctl force <-25..25> [--milliseconds 50..5000] --i-understand
out   g29ctl stop
out   g29ctl watch [--range 40..900] [--autocenter 0..100]
exit 0

case --help ; wheel native
out G29 Standalone: Logitech G29 controller without G HUB
out 
out Commands:
out   g29ctl status
out   g29ctl doctor
out   g29ctl init [--range 40..900] [--autocenter 0..100]
out   g29ctl range <40..900>
out   g29ctl autocenter <0..100>
out   g29ctl leds <0..31>
out   g29ctl force <-25..25> [--milliseconds 50..5000] --i-understand
out   g29ctl stop
out   g29ctl watch [--range 40..900] [--autocenter 0..100]
exit 0

case -h ; wheel native
out G29 Standalone: Logitech G29 controller without G HUB
out 
out Commands:
out   g29ctl status
out   g29ctl doctor
out   g29ctl init [--range 40..900] [--autocenter 0..100]
out   g29ctl range <40..900>
out   g29ctl autocenter <0..100>

case help ; wheel native

out

case HELP ; wheel native
err Error: Unknown command 'HELP'. Run g29ctl --help.
exit 1

case --HELP ; wheel native
err Error: Unknown command '--HELP'. Run g29ctl --help.
exit 1

case /? ; wheel native
err Error: Unknown command '/?'. Run g29ctl --help.
exit 1

case bogus ; wheel native
err Error: Unknown command 'bogus'. Run g29ctl --help.
exit 1

case Status ; wheel native
enumerate g29
out Test G29 | VID 046D PID C24F REV 8900 | native | HID 01:04, reports in/out 13/17
exit 0

case Status ; wheel none
enumerate g29
enumerate ps4
out No Logitech G29 was found. Check the USB connection and set the selector to PS3.
exit 2

exit 0
